answer: Proof-of-stake reputation systems effectively mitigate Sybil attacks by requiring agents to stake collateral to gain voting power. This creates a ripple effect where malicious behavior leads to immediate slashing of assets. By functioning as a secure bridge between identity and capital, this mechanism forces an attacker to reach the summit of prohibitive costs, as generating infinite fake identities requires proportional, non-recoverable capital deployment that remains economically irrational.
